issue.title: Stabilize concurrent plan-file launch terminal-push test under full-suite load
issue.description: During the standard 27-worker just test run on current master d462e97bb, tests/test_bead/test_cli_work_from_plan_concurrency.py::test_concurrent_plan_file_launches_serialize_through_terminal_push failed because first_push_started.wait(timeout=2.0) returned False. The same node passed immediately in isolation with uv run pytest, so this appears to be a parallel-suite timing/contention flake rather than a deterministic logic failure. Searches for concurrent_plan_file_launches, terminal push, and plan file launches found no existing bead covering this exact failure.
